versions.changelog:
- Added documentation reference for ethers.js 6.x (`references/ethers.md`)
- Updated fetch-docs script to support ethers.js documentation retrieval
- Improved legacy frontend stack coverage by including ethers.js references

- Initial release of web3-docs skill.
- Provides up-to-date documentation and code patterns for Solidity, Foundry, Hardhat, Viem, Wagmi, ethers.js, and OpenZeppelin.
- Includes quick lookup references for major EVM development tasks.
- Supports fast access to implementation details for ERC standards, upgradeable contracts, proxy patterns, gas optimization, and more.
- Allows fetching latest docs from official sources using simple scripts.
